bead.title: claude-tui/gate: capture /usage deltas for `claude --print` mode run 2
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013's economic premise hinges on `claude --print` consuming API-metered request paths rather than the subscription window. The second empirical `--print` run is not captured, so the API-metering claim remains under-sampled.

ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md:1 has an empty `--print mode measurements` placeholder and no Run 2 `/usage` snapshots or turn output for this mode.

PROPOSED FIX: Dependency ID: fizeau-a45dafe6. Governing artifact: ADR-013. Using the model, prompt, account, and refresh-delay defined in docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md, run `claude --print` once against the same authenticated account and append a labeled `Run 2` entry to the `--print mode measurements` section. Capture the `/usage` snapshot BEFORE, the full turn output, completion timestamp, and the `/usage` snapshot AFTER at refresh-delay + safety margin, >=60s post-completion. Record wall-clock timestamps for both snapshots and attest no concurrent claude activity from the same account during Run 2.

NON-SCOPE: PTY+hooks measurements, delta computation, verdict determination, ADR-013 disposition, methodology authoring, Runs 1 and 3 capture except for preserving their existing content.

AC:
1) TestPrintModeRun2Labeled: doc's `--print mode measurements` section contains one labeled Run 2 entry.
2) TestPrintModeRun2BeforeAfterSnapshots: Run 2 has BEFORE and AFTER `/usage` snapshot blocks.
3) TestPrintModeRun2TurnOutputRecorded: Run 2 includes the full captured `claude --print` turn output.
4) TestPrintModeRun2SnapshotTimestamps: Run 2 BEFORE and AFTER snapshots each have wall-clock timestamps.
5) TestPrintModeRun2AfterRespectsRefreshDelay: Run 2 AFTER snapshot timestamp is >= completion-time + documented refresh-delay safety margin and >=60s post-completion.
6) TestPrintModeRun2SingleAccountAttested: Run 2 attests no concurrent claude activity from the same account during its measurement window.

GATES: `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestPrintModeRun2Labeled
2) TestPrintModeRun2BeforeAfterSnapshots
3) TestPrintModeRun2TurnOutputRecorded
4) TestPrintModeRun2SnapshotTimestamps
5) TestPrintModeRun2AfterRespectsRefreshDelay
6) TestPrintModeRun2SingleAccountAttested
Gates: `go test ./...`, `lefthook run pre-commit`.
